note: He is a salaried sales lead handling recruiting, staffing and some HR for a property company, previously a school PE teacher and librarian — not a business owner, physician or equivalent. On income he is the clearest miss: he anchored his own expectation at 'above 3k easy', said 'I was not expecting 6k', disclosed credit card debt he needs to clear first, and closed only via a split payment with Klarna held in reserve. And this is restoration after a catastrophic injury and a year on crutches, not good-to-great — his own words are 'I know I had a little hiccup, and I need to get back on it'. He does match on the two remaining criteria and matches them well: health is genuinely the neglected area, squeezed out by a seven-day-a-week job, and he is emphatically not the deconditioned gym-averse exclusion — lean, vegetarian, a marathoner, a martial artist, and already an owner of kettlebells. This is a close from outside the stated ICP on three of five criteria, which is the second such case in the corpus after Robyn Stillwater and further evidence that the stated definition describes the aspiration rather than the buyer. The more useful finding is the one the ICP cannot see at all: it has no clinical criterion, and this prospect's dominant fact is polytrauma with active pain.
